helpScarto: scarto <i0> <i1> ...      dealer discards the talon (alias: discard)
helpSetSeats: ss [3|4]                  seats (3 = 25 cards each / 4 = 19 cards each)
helpExamplePlay: play 0                    play the card at index 0
helpExampleNext: n                         look at the trick, then move on
promptScartoHelp: scarto <i0> ... discard {{n}} cards (no honours, no court cards)
promptPlay: Turn: {{name}} (follow the led suit; trump when void; overtrump when you can)
roundEndFormulaLine: change = seats x your card points - table total (zero sum)
hintReasonScarto: discard the cards that score nothing
hintReasonLead: lead a cheap card and keep the scoring ones
hintReasonFollow: take it if you can, otherwise drop something cheap
hintReasonOvertrump: a trump is out - beat it or drop cheaply
hintReasonNextTrick: press n for the next trick
hintReasonNextRound: press nr for the next deal
discardableLegend: * honours (trump 1/21, Matto) and court cards cannot be discarded
